name: Ljubov' do groba
source: Arriving at the music club building, Semyon (Pioneer) finds not his Miku, but her corpse hanging in a noose. So, it seems it's time to explain things to someone and not return to this issue ever again.
translation: 到达音乐俱乐部大楼后，Semyon（先锋）发现的不是他的Miku，而是挂在绞索上的她的尸体。所以，似乎是时候向某人解释一下事情，而不是再回到这个问题了。
